A mid-century telephone switchboard rebuilt in dark walnut and polished brass, standing alone in a quiet room at the last edge of night just before dawn; rows of jacks and small round indicator lamps, one braided cord patched across the board with its lamp glowing warm amber, a vintage handset resting on the desk; rain on a tall window behind, the sky beyond it a faint cold blue-grey pre-dawn, throwing soft moving light across the wood while the single amber lamp stays the warmest point in the room. Low camera, 35mm anamorphic, switchboard in the right 60 percent, left 40 percent in deep shadow. Palette: bottle green shadow, walnut, brass, one amber lamp, bone highlights.
